newsitem.title: USA: Portland Genl power lines downed by storm.
newsitem.headline: Portland Genl power lines downed by storm.

text.p: About 25,000 Portland General Electric Co (PGE) customers were without power Tuesday morning after a storm pounded the area overnight, a spokeswoman for the Portland, Ore.-based utility said.
At its peak, the storm was blamed for outages to about 100,000 of the utility's customers, with heavy, wet snow knocking down branches and local power distribution lines, she noted.
However, no high-voltage transmission lines were affected by the storm, the PGE spokeswoman said.
The snow has since turned to rain which is forecast to continue through Tuesday. This could lead to more problems for power lines if mudslides result, she added.
